title: Detailed cherries
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='cherryGrad1' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff4d5a'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#d42030'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a0a18'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='cherryGrad2' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b78'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#cc1828'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a0815'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stemGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7bcf5a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3d8a2a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Stems -->
  <path d='M44 42 Q38 30 40 18 Q41 13 46 11' fill='none' stroke='#5abf3a' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 38 Q60 28 56 16 Q54 11 48 9' fill='none' stroke='#4aaf2a' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Stem joint highlight -->
  <path d='M44 42 Q38 30 40 18' fill='none' stroke='#8ae06a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Leaf -->
  <path d='M46 10 Q52 2 62 6 Q58 12 50 11 Z' fill='#6ed44a' stroke='#4aaf2a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M47 10 Q53 5 60 7' fill='none' stroke='#9aeb7a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Left cherry (back) -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='22' fill='url(#cherryGrad1)'/>
  <!-- Left cherry highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='54' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#ff9aa2' opacity='0.6' transform='rotate(-20 31 54)'/>
  <!-- Left cherry dimple top -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='42' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#6a0810' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Right cherry (front) -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='60' r='23' fill='url(#cherryGrad2)'/>
  <!-- Right cherry highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='51' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#ffb0b8' opacity='0.6' transform='rotate(-20 54 51)'/>
  <!-- Right cherry dimple top -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='39' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#60080f' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Right cherry edge shade -->
  <path d='M62 37 A23 23 0 0 1 85 60 A23 23 0 0 1 62 83 A23 23 0 0 1 39 60' fill='none' stroke='#ff8a95' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Sparkle on left cherry -->
  <path d='M30 68 L32 72 L36 73 L32 74 L30 78 L28 74 L24 73 L28 72 Z' fill='#ffe8a0' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Small petiole dots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#8a0a18'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#8a0a18'/>
</svg>
